source: M. H. Prendergast, Short Vocabulary of the Savara Language, prepared 1880 and published after Robert Cust's transmission note in Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society, new series 13 (1881), pp. 425–428
scope: Complete Savara vocabulary on printed pp. 426–428 (p. 425 is the editorial introduction; Cain Koi material is excluded)
rights: The underlying 1881 work is public domain. The Internet Archive original-volume scan, page image, and OCR remain local review cache and are not installed. Only attributed lexical facts and page/item provenance are staged.
provenance: Cust's dated note on printed p. 425 says Assistant Superintendent of Police M. H. Prendergast prepared the Savara vocabulary in 1880 at Vizagapatam; Prendergast sent it to Rev. J. Cain, who transmitted it to Cust. Cust introduced the list. The individual speaker, actual elicitation site, and item dates are not given, so the source-qualified Savara lect has blank coordinates. The preceding Koi paradigms belong to Cain's separate article and are excluded.
transcription: All 266 printed cells on pp. 426–428 are inventoried and visually compared with the original scan. Four cells print two alternatives, emitted as separate variant rows. Historical romanization and macrons/underdots are preserved; uncertain horse/rice glyphs carry typed uncertainty. Parenthetical English explanations within phrase forms are removed from the displayed form but preserved in the audit.
overlap: All 270 rows screened against 2,171 older Sora source rows: 12 exact NFC-casefold form matches, including distinct-sense/homograph cases. No direct historical elicitation dependence proven; retain Prendergast citation and source-local keys.
holds: No unrepresented source cells. Horse and rice glyph readings remain transcription-uncertain and are marked in the installed rows; multiword prompts and grammatical paradigms are retained as attested phrases.
audit: reviewed_inventory.tsv and remaining_inventory.tsv enumerate all 266 cells; import_source.py generates audit.jsonl and the 270-form CSV. Visual-review files record print checks. All 270 rows screened against 2,171 older Sora rows; 12 exact-form overlaps in overlap-review.json.
inapplicable: No native script, dictionary entry numbers, donor claims, etymological labels, or source cognacy assertions occur in this pilot column. No etymology or graph edges are inferred.
deferred: The user prohibited database construction and remote execution. Full CLDF build, compiled graph/reference/identity validation, full suite, and browser QA remain deferred. No browser database was built.
source_pdf_pages: Original pinned 800-page PDF: printed pp. 425–428 are physical PDF pages 471–474; Savara lexical pages are 472–474. Earlier p. 426 pilot audit locator 460 was a mistaken index and is corrected by the current importer.
